svg.title: Burn occurrence model — annotated pipeline
svg.desc: Vertical flowchart with five stages and plain-language descriptions to the right of each box. Input data feeds a base XGBoost classifier with year-blocked cross-validation, then a neighbor-feature convolution, then an autocontext XGBoost with isotonic calibration, then a dashed Stage 2c container with a monthly statewide Poisson submodel that drives a per-month logit shift on the cell probabilities, and finally the calibrated cell-month burn probability — the final target.
